details:
So I've been working on an in-game gamepad powered by OSC that I can use while using hand tracking. However I've run into a pretty big issue that appears to be an issue inherent to how the game handles the OSC gamepad inputs. 

It appears that the gamepad inputs from OSC briefly override the VR inputs. For instance: when sending a signal to move forward continuously via /input/Vertical, the player's vr-tracked hands will briefly jitter/jump ever second or so at a regular interval. It looks as if the hands are going from tracked to not-tracked and back as if perhaps the two input methods are conflicting. This does not appear to affect desktop mode.

My guess is that this is caused by the client going into a sort of half-desktop gamepad-mode where it is assuming im using a gamepad instead of vr controllers. Backing this theory up is the interesting quirk that while the issue is happening the in-game tooltips show the desktop tooltips (right click to use with a picture of a mouse, etc)
Let me know if there is anything I can do to help gather more info about the issue.

Tested on build 1245
title: OSC as Input Controller inputs cause jittering in VR
